messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-02-23, the scheduler's deploy window remains weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-02-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-23]
- The webhook dispatcher's deploy window is on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- As of 2026-03-03, storage for the resizer's original uploads had doubled in six months. [valid 2026-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-03]
- As of 2025-12-01, the resizer lives with Team Dune; the Ember team kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-01-image-resizer]
- Dashboards and alerts for the resizer are being repointed as of 2025-04-29. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]
- On 2026-03-03, Team Dune's standup decided that the resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only. [decision; valid 2026-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-03]
- The catalog service depends on the resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-04-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-15]
- As of 2025-10-27, the scheduler deploys on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-27-2]
    earlier: The scheduler deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-03-19 to 2025-10-27; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19]
- As of 2025-04-29, the Ember team has taken over the resizer from Team Dune. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]
- As of 2025-04-29, the Ember team has taken over the resizer from Team Dune. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]
    earlier: The resizer lives with Team Dune. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-04-29; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-03-2]
- The event bus deploys on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
- Per the change policy, the auth gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-01-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-29]
- As of 2026-04-16, the ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC; the old Wednesday 09:00-11:00 UTC slot is retired. [constraint; valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-16]
    earlier: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to 2026-04-16; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-18]
- As of 2026-03-16, the catalog service deploys on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-16 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-16]
    earlier: The catalog service ships only on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-24 to 2026-03-16; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-24]
- On 2025-05-19, Team Cinder noticed that the resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-05-19 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-19-2]
- On 2026-03-10, Team Dune observed that after Tuesday's deploy, the reporting service's p99 latency doubled. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- The billing service has no deploys from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-04]
- The reporting service may be released only on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC, and any other release time requires an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-02-25 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-02-25]
- As of 2026-05-25, Team Atlas has switched to a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2]

Question: What is the deploy window for image-resizer?
